course.title: Sustainability Training
objectives: Understand the basic concepts of sustainability.

slides.title: Welcome to Sustainability Training
slides.content: Welcome to the course. In this training, you will learn about the key principles of sustainability and how they apply in the workplace.

slides.title: What is Sustainability?
slides.content: Sustainability means meeting present needs while protecting the ability of future generations to meet their needs.

slides.title: Key Sustainability Pillars
slides.content: The major pillars include environmental, social and economic sustainability.

slides.title: The Three Pillars of Sustainability
slides.content: Sustainability is commonly understood through environmental, social and economic dimensions.
